summary: OAuth access tokens are often bearer tokens, meaning anyone who steals one can use it. DPoP (Demonstrating Proof of Possession) has the client prove at the application level that it holds a particular key each time it uses a token. This makes stolen access and refresh tokens much harder to replay.

eli5.summary: A movie ticket that anyone can use is risky if you drop it. DPoP is like also showing a secret handshake only you know, so a stranger holding your ticket can't get in.

questions: how to prevent oauth token replay
